text: Why should a wireless site survey account for building sensors and BLE beacons?
choices: Zigbee and BLE occupy 2.4 GHz alongside Wi-Fi, so a dense sensor deployment is part of your noise floor
explanation: A survey that ignores non-Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz occupancy will mispredict, and a Wi-Fi analyser cannot see them at all — a spectrum analyser is required.
